title: Free Radical Scavenging Activity Protocol
author: Jorge Carlos Ruiz Ruiz
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.sfpebmn

steps.title: Add DPPH and incubate
steps.instruction: Add DPPH solution to each aqueous extract, shake, and incubate under specified conditions.

substeps.instruction: Add 3 mL of 0.1 mM DPPH solution in methanol to each aqueous extract.
Allow the mixture to stand for 30 min at room temperature in the dark.

steps.title: Measure absorbance
steps.instruction: Record the absorbance of each reaction mixture at the appropriate wavelength, including controls and standards.

substeps.instruction: Measure absorbance of each sample at 517 nm.
Use distilled water as the blank control.
Use ascorbic acid as the standard.

steps.title: Calculate inhibition percentage
steps.instruction: Determine the free‑radical scavenging activity using the absorbance values.

substeps.instruction: Calculate % inhibition = (A0 − A1) / A0 × 100, where A0 is the control absorbance and A1 is the sample absorbance.

steps.title: Determine IC50 value
steps.instruction: Quantify antioxidant activity by deriving the concentration that gives 50 % inhibition.

substeps.instruction: Plot % scavenging versus phenolic compound concentration in the aqueous extract.
Perform regression analysis to obtain the IC50 (concentration causing 50 % inhibition).
Use ascorbic acid as the control reference.
